text: {"lessons":["I should judge the whole portfolio, not each stock by whether it is above my purchase price; my cost basis does not predict what happens next.","Selling winners feels comfortable, but I should not sell just to lock in a gain or avoid admitting a loss; each decision should reflect the stock’s future prospects and my portfolio needs.","Recent price changes are not reliable forecasts, so I should avoid frequent trades based on noise and keep a disciplined plan that accounts for the discomfort of losses."]}
